_about: Captions for the opening and ending cutscenes (Docs/Design/01, 08). 'at' and 'duration' are seconds from the start. Camera moves and effects are timed in CutsceneSystem.cs (opening ~37 s, ending ~23 s); keep captions inside those lengths.

opening.speaker: TV
opening.text: ...a tropical storm off the coast is expected to strengthen into a hurricane by tomorrow evening...

opening.speaker: TV
opening.text: ...residents are urged to begin preparations now.

opening.speaker: TV
opening.text: ...and it's a corner kick... the keeper is off his line...

opening.speaker: TV
opening.text: HURRICANE IS COMING. Landfall expected this evening.

ending.text: Outside, the street is in ruins. The house is still standing.
